mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and 82 degrees at Verona City Hall. Tonight, we have a Waning Crescent moon, and you can catch the ISS passing overhead at 9:06 PM, rising over Mount Horeb and traveling toward Madison near Home Depot. Expect an overnight low of 59 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

City news includes the closure of the Military Ridge State Trail between Lincoln and South Franklin Street from September 14 through mid-November for bridge work, with detours in place. Also, the Plan Commission is reviewing several development projects for their October 5 meeting.

Today is busy with Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia at both The Mill and The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can enjoy Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they initiated an investigation into a case of sexual assault of a child by a school staff member, which remains an open investigation.
Today's flavor is the rich Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM this evening.
